_about: Agenda Ahead New York wave 2 (2026-11): 121 more New York towns, villages, cities and county planning boards (battery-storage moratoria per Carina's monitor and 2026 town documents, data-center and warehouse fights, the Capital Region, the wave-1 places not promoted, and the counties' 239-m referral boards). Same row shape as towns_ny.json plus kind, selection_group / selection_reason / selection_source; county rows carry attribute_townships and county_body; places read only through their county carry coverage "via_county". Built by `python3 experiments/wave2_test.py discover`. Kept outside data/towns_*.json because New York is a published state; promotion = `wave2_test.py promote --wave 2`, which moves rows into data/towns_ny.json.
gate_note: Wave 2 test rows: not part of the production daily run or site (this file is outside the data/towns_*.json glob). Crawled only by `python3 -m watch351.daily --data-dir ../data/test/wave2/config --states NY --output-dir ../data/test/wave2/ny --hits-name hits_ny_wave2.json` (experiments/wave2_test.py crawl).
evidence_rule: a board is automated only if its listing shows >=1 agenda/packet/notice dated within [today-120d, today+120d] and the first such document is fetchable under robots.txt
